captions.detailed: A cinema macro lens featuring a long cylindrical black body with dual geared adjustment bands. The wider front band serves as a focus ring, while the narrower rear band acts as the iris ring. A small, light-colored slider tab is mounted in a longitudinal slot on the side of the main barrel. Both the focus and iris rings rotate continuously around the main lens body, while the marker tab moves linearly along its slot.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a black cinema macro lens. It should feature a main cylindrical lens body, a wide continuous-rotation focus ring with geared ridges, a narrower continuous-rotation iris ring near the rear, and a prismatic sliding magnification marker tab on the side of the barrel.
captions.factory: Create a main lens body using nested cylinders and boolean subtraction for the core cavity. Model the geared focus and iris rings by creating cylindrical bands and subtracting or adding polar-patterned rectangular teeth. Create the sliding marker tab as a small block, and define continuous rotational joints for both rings and a prismatic joint with linear limits for the sliding marker tab.
